scripts.build: export FOLDKIT_BUILD_ID="${FOLDKIT_BUILD_ID:-$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)}"; node --import vibelang/register ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --configLoader native --config vite.config.vibe
scripts.openapi: node --import vibelang/register ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --configLoader native --config vite.scripts.config.ts --ssr scripts/openApi.ts --outDir dist-scripts && node dist-scripts/openApi.js
scripts.preprerender: export FOLDKIT_BUILD_ID="${FOLDKIT_BUILD_ID:-$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)}"; node --import vibelang/register ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --configLoader native --config vite.config.vibe --ssr src/entry.server.vibe --outDir dist-server
scripts.prerender: node --import vibelang/register ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --configLoader native --config vite.scripts.config.ts --ssr scripts/runPrerender.ts --outDir dist-scripts && node dist-scripts/runPrerender.js
scripts.preview:search: pnpm build && pnpm prerender && node --import vibelang/register ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js preview --configLoader native --config vite.config.vibe
